rule: packages that build on x86_64 and fail on ppc64le in openSUSE:Factory (against Factory:PowerPC) or in a devel project; without multibuild flavors, sources up to 500 MiB, the last build at most 20 min on each architecture; the failure in %build or %check for a reason of the architecture, read in the ppc64le log. Left out: failures of the RPM packaging only (%install, file lists: 111, of them 99 Go packages whose binary crashes in the Go 1.27 runtime on the OBS ppc64le workers, as do about 10 more Go packages in %build and %check), builds that hang, kernel modules, x86-only tools, and failures of the build environment (dependency versions of the port, timing, network). Chosen for diversity of the cause, not at random: report results per group.
use: on the build host, each case's new_case command creates it (make new-case), then build.sh, the acceptance test and make baseline as in docs/TUTORIAL.md; a case whose baseline builds, or fails for another reason, gives its place to a reserve
